# Cache module

One set of methods for several caches: files, SQLite, APCu, Memcached and Redis.

Part of [Kohana 4](https://github.com/uBizzy/kohana4).

```php
// application/bootstrap.php
Kohana::modules([
	'cache' => MODPATH.'cache',
]);
```

The full documentation is in `guide/cache/` and in the user guide of your application.
